title: Thumbnails, media API dimensions and pre-sized gallery containers for a self-hosted media vault
derivation: Private media-vault PR #8 (thumbnail generation function storing original dimensions in blob metadata, media-list API returning thumbnailUrl/width/height, carousel using thumbnails with pre-sized containers and full-size fullscreen) re-synthesized as sanitized framework-free JavaScript modules over an in-memory blob store with injected probe/resize. No private code, event names, URLs or media are included.
coverage: Backend thumbnail pipeline (planning, orientation, failure isolation, skip/force, metadata), API contract and gallery layout across three files, on held-out albums.
historical_exposure: Private history; synthetic fixture has low recognition risk.
residual_rubric: Visual layout quality and spinner UX are not graded.
